article_title: Trump Sends ICE to Help at Airports
article_content:
As our editor Bob Hoge reported, President Donald Trump took to Truth Social on Saturday to announce that he would authorize the deployment of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents to the nation's airports, in order to help quell the travel chaos caused by the shortage of Transportation and Safety Administration (TSA) staffing and overwhelmed TSA agents.
It's been over 30 days since TSA personnel have been paid. Many have been calling out and not showing up to work, and even more have quit. This is thanks to the Democrats' failure to fund DHS because they want ICE defunded and abolished. Now, those very ICE agents can be seen in 14 airports, doing a wonderful job of creating smooth operations and mitigating the hours-long delays that were previously experienced over the past several weeks.
🚨 BREAKING: CNN was just FORCED to report that ICE agents helped TSA lower Atlanta airport wait times down below an hour
— Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh) March 23, 2026
"You can see ICE agents behind me RIGHT THERE!"
"And some more over here!"
"They've been doing patrols."
This frees up TSA for screening. LFG! 🔥🔥 pic.twitter.com/uVP56gyIyk
Lo and Behold, the Left began peddling a video showing ICE apprehending a mother and her young daughter at San Francisco International (SFO) Airport. Some of the posters of the video claimed the woman is a U.S. citizen, which only deepened their "ICE Gestapo" narrative.

She could not prove her citizenship to satisfaction of the agents—and was violently taken into ICE custody.
San Francisco Airport pic.twitter.com/d1WXpZwIm3
Here's another one, duly dated for Sunday, March 22, claiming disruption at SFO because of ICE. It even gives the gate number — so VERY helpful.
Chaos erupts at San Francisco International Airport pic.twitter.com/Ug2WLvFtt8
— Surajit (@surajit_ghosh2) March 23, 2026
As surely as the sun rises, the brain trust of Democrat elected officials got in on the game. Democrat Rep. Eric Swalwell (CA-14) is predictably tedious.
The shocking video of a mother being wrestled to the ground by ICE agents as her daughter cries in terror is precisely why deploying that rogue agency to airports is a bad idea. Get ICE out of airports, get them out of California, and abolish them.https://t.co/lcDIVkVDDV
— Eric Swalwell (@ericswalwell) March 23, 2026
As is his colleague, Rep. Daniel Goldman (NY-10).
ICE is not at airports to help TSA and reduce lines. They are there (without identification) trying to arrest people, exactly as I predicted.
— Daniel Goldman (@danielsgoldman) March 23, 2026
ICE must be abolished. https://t.co/5BvfgpEQDm
Then there's California State Senator Scott Wiener, the purported heir to Rep. Nancy Pelosi's (CA-11) seat. Wiener declared that this Sunday apprehension by ICE was them "terrorizing" the mother and daughter.
ICE was at SFO airport last night, terrorizing a mother while her daughter watched. So much for the “hey we’re sending ICE to airports to fill in for TSA” BS.
— Senator Scott Wiener (@Scott_Wiener) March 23, 2026
ICE OUT OF CALIFORNIA pic.twitter.com/lcnjOV5HPs
Oh, the horror! Now ICE is in the airports, arresting U.S. citizens, and traumatizing travelers. ICE Out! We warned you! The president and DHS are making efforts to alleviate the problem that Democrats created. Predictably, Democrats complain about the solution and attempt to throw a wrench in, as these anti-ICE protesters indicate. On Monday, these people magically showed up at Hartsfield-Jackson Airport in Atlanta, pre-printed signs and all.
Notice the lack of melanin among the protesters in what is known as a "Chocolate city." Can you say, "astroturf," boys and girls?
Yeah.
🚨 LMFAO! Paid protestors just started RANTING about Donald Trump as ICE agents literally clear out TSA lines in the Atlanta airport
— Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh) March 23, 2026
"Trump, let's be clear, immigrants are welcome here!!" 🤡
So while ICE HELPS Americans, paid protestors act like idiots 🤣pic.twitter.com/UXkhqRJ1Pv
There are two problems with these takes: The video does show ICE agents detaining a woman and her child at SFO. However, 1) the woman is indeed an illegal alien with a removal order dating back to 2019; and, 2) the video was from Sunday, a full day before any ICE agents were stationed in America's airports.
Womp Wah.
The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) posted this on Monday afternoon, setting the record straight on exactly what occurred in the video.

While being escorted to the international terminal for processing, Lopez-Jimenez attempted to flee and resisted law enforcement officers. ICE is working as quickly as possible to repatriate the family unit to their home country of Guatemala.
From all appearances and the DHS message, no U.S. citizens or illegal aliens were harmed in the making of this video. Just ICE doing their sworn duty.
